text:
Saigon. I am sitting in the Continental restaurant having coffee in the morning. This is where all The press had coffee at. Most likely sitting with Ronnie Tototz. Just up the street to the right is a big movie theater where I watched a Vietnamese or Chinese movie. No idea what the movie was. It was a bloody film of a bunch of people killing a bunch of people. 

To the right is the road that takes you back to Ton Suhn Knut as well as the river where the kids where swimming.

The road on the left of the photo is Saigon main drag. That's where the Presidential Palace is at, maybe 2 blocks or 2 and half blocks up.
